business_summary: KFM Kingdom Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, manufactures and sells precision metal stamping products in the People's Republic of China, South East Asia, Hong Kong, North America, Europe, and internationally. The company manufactures and sells fine metal products; and provides management services. It also provides integrated services, including design engineering solutions; prototyping, CNC laser cutting, CNC tooling design and tooling mold design, metal stamping parts, and lathing or machining parts; hard tooling and soft tooling services; secondary processing services comprising laser welding or robotic argon welding, tapping, drilling, polishing, and sand blasting; and post-treatment processing services, such as silk screening printing, heat treatment, plating, and coating, as well as product assembly and quality testing services. In addition, the company offers packaging solutions; and engages in property investment activities, as well as supply chain management services. It serves medical and test equipment, finance equipment, consumer electronics, network/data storage, and office automation industries. KFM Kingdom Holdings Limited was founded in 1987 and is headquartered in Tsuen Wan, Hong Kong. KFM Kingdom Holdings Limited is a subsidiary of Kig Real Estate Holdings Limited.
